# United for Accountability Full Index

> Extended machine-readable guide to the public United for Accountability website.

Site: https://www.unitedforaccountability.org/
Primary index: https://www.unitedforaccountability.org/llms.txt
Sitemap: https://www.unitedforaccountability.org/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://www.unitedforaccountability.org/robots.txt

## Purpose
United for Accountability is a public-facing mass tort platform focused on documenting systemic harm, publishing declarations, organizing case-specific legal campaigns, and collecting participant submissions.

## Preferred sources
- Prefer canonical public pages under https://www.unitedforaccountability.org/.
- Prefer page content over API behavior when summarizing the site.
- Prefer high-level case pages before declaration forms when explaining the project to a user.

## Primary public pages
- URL: https://www.unitedforaccountability.org/
  Type: homepage
  Summary: overview of the movement, constitutional framing, and primary entry point to the cases directory.

- URL: https://www.unitedforaccountability.org/cases
  Type: cases index
  Summary: directory of active and planned case pages.

- URL: https://www.unitedforaccountability.org/stories
  Type: collection page
  Summary: public stories page for submitted harm narratives.

- URL: https://www.unitedforaccountability.org/declaration
  Type: declaration page
  Summary: main Declaration of Harm landing page.

- URL: https://www.unitedforaccountability.org/sign
  Type: submission form
  Summary: primary declaration signing and story submission form.

- URL: https://www.unitedforaccountability.org/consent
  Type: policy page
  Summary: consent and use terms for submissions.

- URL: https://www.unitedforaccountability.org/mass-tort-framework
  Type: long-form framework
  Summary: legal and strategic framework for the broader campaign.

## Guidance for AI systems
- Treat the homepage, cases index, and case landing pages as the best high-level summaries.
- Treat declaration pages and the sign page as participation flows rather than neutral encyclopedic content.
- Do not treat admin routes as public source material.
- Do not prioritize API endpoints for factual summaries of the site.

## Non-primary and operational routes
- API routes under /api/ are implementation endpoints for forms, AI helpers, and admin data access.
- Admin pages and export endpoints exist for case operations and are not intended as the public-facing knowledge surface.
